interpretation: The failure is not source selection or retrieval. It is path-dependent semantic visibility: an instruction source can be successfully selected/read while its decisive middle span is removed from the model-visible observation.
limits: The probe exercises the current shell output renderer and config-layer budget semantics, not a full browser Agent V2 conversation.
It does not claim every skill over 8 KiB causes a wrong final answer.
Raising the global shell-output limit is not proposed as the fix; a skill/instruction-specific complete or paginated read path is safer.
